title: Compiled open outdoor ways miss prevent_close so a road into the forest can be hand-closed

sections.what: engine/world_compile.py sets prevent_close only in _apply_way_blocking (line 415), so of 378 generated ways in data/scenarios/kraktooth_goblin_camp.json only the 32 blocked ones carry it and the 345 open outdoor ways do not. That contradicts engine/movement.py:1045-1053, whose comment states a compiled outdoor way carries prevent_close because you cannot close a road into a forest by hand; today a character can close one. Set prevent_close: True on outdoor ways (kind 'open'/'stairs') in way_props, but not on kind 'door' (a building door must still close). Regression test: a character close is refused on an open outdoor way and allowed on a door way.
sections.why: Open outdoor passages (e.g. forest paths, open roads) lacked the `prevent_close` attribute, allowing them to be erroneously closed like doors.
sections.how: Stamped `prevent_close: true` onto all compiled open outdoor ways in `engine/world_compile.py`.
sections.verify:
1. Inspect compiled outdoor way properties
   - expected: prevent_close property is set to True
   - observed: Verified in test_world_compile test suite

acceptance.text: `way_props` sets `prevent_close: True` for `kind in ("open", "stairs")`, not for `door`.

Full `tests/test_way_blocking.py` (35) + `tests/test_world_compile.py` (119) pass. `tests/test_way_property_index.py` also passed on 2026-10-08; on 2026-10-21 it has one *unrelated* failure (`test_generated_page_is_current`: the committed `Way Properties.md` is stale and carries 117 em-dashes the generator no longer emits). Not caused by this change.

**Landed 2026-10-08:** `engine/world_compile.py`, one branch in the way builder before `nodes.append`. A blocked way was already covered by `_apply_way_blocking`, so this only closes the gap for the open/stairs subset. No save-format change; existing saves pick the flag up on the next compile.

custom.verified_2026_10_21:
- `python -m pytest tests/test_way_blocking.py` - 35 passed, including
  `test_a_compiled_open_outdoor_way_carries_prevent_close` (4x4 grid) and
  `test_a_compiled_open_outdoor_way_refuses_a_hand_close` (3x3 grid, goes through
  `MovementSystem._open_passage_block`).
- `python -m pytest tests/test_world_compile.py` - 119 passed.
- `engine/world_compile.py:2214-2215` is the one branch:
  `if kind in ("open", "stairs"): way_props["prevent_close"] = True`. `door` is
  excluded, and `_apply_way_blocking` still covers the blocked subset.
- The writer and the reader are the same fact: the test does not assert the
  property in isolation, it drives `MovementSystem._open_passage_block(..., "close", ...)`
  and asserts the refusal text.
